summary: End-to-end ML platforms provide integrated tooling for the full model lifecycle—data preparation, experiment tracking, training, fine-tuning, deployment, and monitoring—at enterprise scale. You need one when you are building, customizing, or operating your own models (including fine-tuned LLMs) with governance, reproducibility, and scaling requirements; if you only need inference from an existing foundation model, a managed model API is simpler and cheaper. The 2026 landscape is dominated by the three hyperscaler platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML) plus Databricks, with specialized MLOps and AutoML players clustering below them.

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute instance-hours, storage, and endpoint usage; no upfront fees
platforms.best_for: AWS-native teams wanting a broad, service-oriented, end-to-end ML platform with maximum control

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by training/prediction compute, node-hours, and token usage for foundation models
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting unified AutoML plus access to Gemini and Google foundation models on GCP

platforms.name: Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute (VM instance-hours), storage, and endpoint usage; enterprise agreements available
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft ecosystem wanting OpenAI/Copilot integration via Azure AI Foundry

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based using DBUs (Databricks Units) on top of underlying cloud compute
platforms.best_for: Unified data + AI teams doing heavy data engineering and collaborative, multi-cloud ML/LLM work

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free for individuals; team/enterprise tiers priced per seat/usage, plus self-hosted enterprise licensing
platforms.best_for: ML research and engineering teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking and LLM observability

platforms.name: MLflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; managed versions billed via Databricks or cloud hosting costs
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting a vendor-neutral, open-source standard for tracking and model lifecycle management

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.pricing: Enterprise subscription/licensing, typically custom quoted; consumption options available
platforms.best_for: Enterprises and business analysts wanting automated end-to-end ML with strong governance and low code

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; Driverless AI and enterprise GenAI products via commercial licensing
platforms.best_for: Organizations needing AutoML with explainability and flexible on-prem/open-source deployment

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-second billing for CPU/GPU compute; free starter credits
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting fast serverless GPU infrastructure for training and deploying models without managing clusters

platforms.name: Kubeflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; cost is underlying Kubernetes/cloud infrastructure
platforms.best_for: Platform teams building portable, Kubernetes-native ML infrastructure across clouds and on-prem
